scope: Pre-run source, mathematics and input identity review only; separately authored review and independent local calculations.

input_hash_audit.method: Recursively traversed path+sha256 records from V2 contract and V2 manifest, independently hashed actual bytes; checked recorded byte sizes. Includes both complete FFD binaries.

code_review.physical_phase_comparison: PASS: Native Tx0 H compared to SourceFFD.physical_h_col; no fitted phase or gain.
code_review.source_internal: PASS: independent p0_initial.direct algebra; identical verified banks and actual pose distance.
code_review.detector: PASS: symmetric N-1 Hann, 4N IFFT times257, strongest RX 30 percent first leading edge, common tap for both RX; independent selection for Full and LoS.
code_review.range_model: PASS: preserves d+B_OLD and separates source detector range from continuous model range.
code_review.tap_and_branch: PASS: exact Native vs Source tap and strongest-branch gates.
code_review.jacobian: PASS: stable cells/tap/branch required; crossing never counted as finite-difference PASS. All selected GT poses outside source pole cap.
code_review.native_acquisition: PASS: both modes call original Sionna PathSolver separately at all257 frequencies; no interpolation or direct-component substitution.
code_review.raw_coefficient_reconstruction: PASS_BY_CODE_REVIEW: H=sum_p a_p exp(-j2pi f tau_p); raw coefficients, delays, path offsets, interaction types and objects retained for independent post-run reconstitution.
code_review.solver_and_materials: PASS_BY_CODE_REVIEW: exact original Full solver JSON and six mesh/material bindings required; all reference bytes checked before acquisition.
code_review.full_direct_component: PASS_BY_CODE_REVIEW: unique zero-interaction geometric-delay path perbin; compared to separately generated LoS H at inherited relative threshold5e-4.
code_review.surface_attribution: PASS_BY_CODE_REVIEW: ENVIRONMENT records native object_id to original surface names.
code_review.failure_retention: PASS_BY_CODE_REVIEW: completed native bins and last returned coefficients retained in partial NPZ if a later call/check throws; complete pose physics failures preserve complete NPZ.
code_review.source_hash_guard: PASS: request, pose, trajectory manifest, solver/material refs, all code files and inherited contracts checked.
code_review.runtime: PASS_FOR_CANARY_ONLY: pinned NumPy1.26.4, SciPy1.14.1, SionnaRT2.0.1, Mitsuba3.8.0, DrJit1.3.1 verified. Python3.12.14 differs from historical3.11 and is disclosed; physical parity remains to be measured.

observer_direct_inverse_dft.method: Direct 1028x257 inverse-DFT matrix with sin(pi*k/256)^2 window, independently calculated branch/tap/power; no FFT used in oracle.

source_on_actual_R1B_canaries.note: Source/direct mathematical checks only. These are not Native RT canary results.

not_admitted_by_this_receipt: full917pose production before G1 PASS, separate post-canary audit and measured cost lock
P2/P3 scoring before its corresponding gates
P4 correction fitting or use of missing predictions
scientific validation or manuscript performance claims
remaining_required_evidence: measured timing and memory cost lock
committed execution SHA and run logs
